title: Invoice Line Code (INVOICE-LINE-CODE@v1) - Output Schema (invoice-line-code)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='invoice-line-code' (ebilling-r1 task 047, FR-22, D-52). Deployed by scripts/Deploy-ActionMirrors.ps1 as the sprk_outputschemajson sidecar of infra/dataverse/actions/invoice-line-code.action.json. It MUST stay in step with IInvoiceAi.CodeLinesAsync's parser (InvoiceAiOutputParser.ParseCodeLines in Services/Ai/PublicContracts/InvoiceAi.cs) and the result DTOs (InvoiceAiContracts.cs: InvoiceCodeLinesResult, InvoiceLineCoding, InvoiceLineObservation); tests/integration/contract/Catalog/InvoiceLineCodeActionContractTests.cs pins the three together. The code properties are plain nullable strings on purpose: the allowed codes differ per invoice (the line's resolved code set), the platform's $choices enrichment only reaches top-level string properties, and LineCodingService validates every returned code against the resolved set server-side (FR-22), so a static enum here would be both unenforceable and stale. Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required arrays, every property listed in required (optional values are nullable, not omitted).
$comment-required: Object-level required arrays only - property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator).

lines.description: One entry per input line, in input order, carrying the input lineKey.

lineKey.description: The lineKey of the input line this entry codes, copied exactly.

taskCode.description: UTBMS task code copied exactly from allowedTaskCodes, or null when none fits or the line is an Expense line.

activityCode.description: UTBMS activity code copied exactly from allowedActivityCodes, or null when none fits or the line is an Expense line.

expenseCode.description: UTBMS expense code copied exactly from allowedExpenseCodes, or null when none fits or the line is a Fee line.

confidence.description: Certainty in the codes returned for this line, 0.0 to 1.0. Below 0.5 when the narrative is too thin to code reliably.

observations.description: Problems with the time entry itself; an empty array when there are none.

type.description: BlockBilling: several distinct tasks lumped into one time entry. VagueDescription: a narrative too generic to show what work was done.

confidence.description: Certainty that the observation applies, 0.0 to 1.0.

quotedText.description: The text copied verbatim from the line's narrative that the observation is about (the shortest span that shows it, or the whole narrative).
